name: meteoric-volley-copies-each-aethercharge-in-the-attackers-intent
notes: Player 2's Ranger champion attacks with an Aetherwing loaded with Aether's Embrace and responds with Meteoric Volley. (The intent objects are still present in the final snapshot.)

rulesClauses: For each Aethercharge card in the attacker's intent, create a copy of it in that attacker's intent.
